title: Minimum Weighted Subgraph With the Required Paths
goal: Find the minimum-weight directed subgraph letting both sources reach the destination.
strategy: The two routes may share a suffix after a meeting vertex. Compute shortest distances from both sources and to the destination, then minimize their sum at every possible meeting vertex.
